name: Seealpsee, Aescher and Ebenalp
why: From Wasserauen to the green Seealpsee, then up to the Aescher, a mountain inn built into a cliff, and through a cave chapel to Ebenalp.
book: Free; cable car down from Ebenalp. Train to Wasserauen from Appenzell.
water: Inns at the lake, Aescher and Ebenalp.
dangers: Steep path to the Aescher, slippery when wet.

points.name: Wasserauen
points.note: The end of the Appenzell railway.

points.name: Seealpsee
points.note: A green lake under the Säntis cliffs.

points.name: Aescher
